relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: fgets reads attacker-controlled data from the PoC file into the heap-allocated buffer thisline. The PoC data begins with a NUL byte (0x00), so the buffer's first byte is '\0'.

The code unconditionally dereferences *(end - 1) without first checking that end > line. When end == line (because the string is empty due to a leading NUL byte), end - 1 points before the heap buffer. The fix adds the guard end > line before the dereference.

Writes a NUL byte at end - 1. With end == line == thisline, this writes to thisline - 1, which is 1 byte before the start of the 2048-byte heap allocation. ASan detects heap-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 1 at 1 byte to the left of the allocated region.
After end = line + strlen(line), end == line because thisline[0] == 0x00 causes strlen to return 0.

edges.description: The pointer end computed at line 1882 (end == line due to strlen returning 0) propagates unchanged to the dereference at line 1909.
